$comment: Levelupp AIDLC hooks (Plane 1, M_AIDLC Plugin §5). All are command hooks using ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; none writes into the customer repo (cache under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/levelupp). SessionStart uses http/command (NOT mcp_tool) because MCP servers typically aren't connected yet at SessionStart (timing, F1). PreToolUse does local classification first (no network for the common case), an offline MUST-NEVER deny, then curls authorize-action only for gated classes.
